title: J9 Legacy Skate Fundraiser
description: Join us for a fun-filled evening of skating!
additionalInfo: All ages welcome. Ticket purchases will be made at the venue, but please RSVP below for us to get a gauge for the number of attendees.

title: Memorial 3 by Lacrosse Jamboree
description: 3by lacrosse is fast paced, free flowing game which heavily emphasizes skill and quick decision making under pressure. It's a finesse and skill game, and not a strength and power game.
additionalInfo: The foundation hosted a 3 by jamboree on Saturday November 30th, 2024, in honor of Jacob Eshenbaugh, who passed away on May 23, 2024.
thankYouMessage: Thank you to all the young athletes who participated in this special event honoring Jacob's memory. Your energy and sportsmanship made the day truly memorable!
